_note: Synthetic line set for Phase 1b: 30 plain + 15 tool. voice: macOS `say` voice (Rishi = Indian English, also for Latin-script Hinglish; Lekha = Hindi). ' | ' marks a mid-sentence pause of pause_ms (default 700), to test false cut-offs. Lines are played in this order, split into sessions of at most 23 lines.

lines.text: Hi Benchmate, can you hear me?
Read the meter please.
बूट करंट क्या होता है?
V BAT ka matlab kya hai?
Supply kitna dikha raha hai?
What does diode mode measure?
Can you explain | what boot current means?
मीटर पढ़ो।
मल्टीमीटर पर डायोड मोड कैसे लगाते हैं?
Boot current ka matlab | thoda samjhao.
Can you read the supply display?
What does O L mean on the multimeter?
डायोड मोड में | मीटर क्या दिखाता है?
Probe laga diya, | ab meter padho.
Ruko, ek minute.
What is the unit of current?
I have placed the probes. Read the meter.
ग्राउंड पॉइंट क्या होता है?
Diode mode aur continuity mein kya farak hai?
सप्लाई कितना दिखा रहा है?
What does the current limit | on the supply actually do?
What is a short circuit, in one line?
Meter padho, probe laga diya hai.
शॉर्ट सर्किट का मतलब क्या है?
O L ka matlab kya hota hai?
Okay, read the | meter now.
What does the beep in continuity mode mean?
सप्लाई का करंट लिमिट | क्या होता है?
मीटर की रीडिंग बताओ।
Ground point | kahan hota hai board pe?
What is the difference between volts and amps?
What does the supply show now?
करंट की यूनिट क्या है?
Short circuit ek line mein samjhao.
Meter ki reading batao.
What does V BAT stand for?
Which probe usually goes on ground in diode mode?
प्रोब लगा दिया है, | अब मीटर पढ़ो।
Aage chalo.
Okay, I am back.
Check the meter reading.
ठीक है, धन्यवाद।
What is a ground point on the board?
Supply ka current batao.
Theek hai, thank you.
